$comment: Lighthouse CI config. See https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse-ci. LCP/CLS use Google Core Web Vitals 'good' thresholds; performance score starts at warn=0.85 and will be tightened (or relaxed, with rationale) once we collect ~10 main-branch baseline runs. INP is intentionally omitted — Lighthouse can't measure interaction latency without user actions. The CI workflow starts `vite preview` and waits for it via `wait-on` BEFORE invoking lhci, so this config does not use startServerCommand/startServerReadyPattern (the latter was flaky against vite preview's non-tty stdout). The target URL is intentionally NOT set here: the workflow step (and the README local-run snippet) passes `--collect.url=http://127.0.0.1:4173/` on the lhci CLI so the port lives next to the `vite preview --port 4173` invocation — a single source of truth that's easier to keep in sync than two files.
